title: Cutover Kiln: schedule and notes (Mar 2027) - WIP
content:
Purpose: working timetable + compact checklists for the ‘Cutover Kiln’ release lane. This doc is a living notesheet: runbook fragments, timing windows, gating heuristics and draft release notes to paste into the formal release object.

High level goal:
- Move hosted-api v2.3.0 -> v2.4.0 with latency improvements and model routing changes while preserving SLA.
- Keep error-rate <= 0.25% and median p95 latency change <= +10ms.

Release window (target):
- Primary cutover: 2027-03-18 22:00 - 23:30 PDT (UTC-7)
- Canary window: 2027-03-18 21:00 - 22:00 PDT (10% traffic)
- Post-cutover stabilization: 2027-03-18 23:30 - 2027-03-20 23:59 PDT

Preflight (T-minus 72h): short checklist (owner tags)
- Feature flags: confirm toggles for model routing exist and default false (Diego)
- Infra: reserved capacity checked (Katherine), GPU pool headroom >= 25%
- Evals: smoke prompt sets run against staging (Omar)
- Backups: export config snapshots and KV-cache flush plan (Maya)
- Communications: ops channel created + paging list validated (Evelyn)

T-minus 2h: on-deck checklist
- Run staging smoke tests (happy path, cold-start, long context) -> pass required (>=95%)
- Confirm A/B test traffic wiring for canary is ready (10% slice)
- Ensure fallback model variant is staged and healthy
- Acquire manual rollback token and document rollback URL

Canary procedure (21:00 - 22:00):
- Ramp to 10% over 5 minutes, monitor for first 15 minutes
- Telemetry gates (automated): error-rate, p99 latency, token cost delta. Gate thresholds: error-rate < 0.25% absolute, p99 delta < +30ms, token cost delta < +12%
- If any gate trips: immediate abort, redirect canary traffic to previous stable version, open incident ticket and notify SRE on-call

Cutover sequence (22:00):
1) Freeze new deploys (feature freeze) 21:50
2) Stop background batch jobs that inject load at 21:55
3) Apply migration scripts in maintenance window (if any) 22:00 (dry-run logged)
4) Switch routing policy to primary release variant in 2 waves over 10 minutes
5) Re-enable background jobs after p95 latency stable for 15 minutes

Rollback quick-reference:
- Soft rollback: flip routing policy to stable model variant (takes <60s); notify in-channel and annotate rollout ticket
- Hard rollback: deploy hotpatch (release-rollback-hotfix branch) and restart serving processes; expected downtime up to 120s for affected pods
- Post-rollback: collect trace samples, binary logs and upload to /artifacts/release-3142/rollback-YYYYMMDD

Observability and signals to watch (primary):
- Customer-facing errors (HTTP 5xx, 4xx increase pattern)
- Inference service metrics: token-per-second, batch sizes, queue depth, KV cache hit ratio
- Business signals: queued requests for enterprise tenants, rate-limit throttle count
- Evals: sampled prompt diffs for model-output regression on red-team prompts

Communications plan:
- Pre-cutover notification in #releases 24h and 1h before
- During canary: minute-by-minute short updates (who/what/ok?)
- After cutover: release digest (what changed, known issues, mitigations) posted to #releases and Confluence

Draft Release Notes (to be cleaned for external release notes):
- Release v2.4.0: primary changes
  * Model routing optimizer: reduces average latency for multi-turn chat by ~8–12% on p50
  * Improved KV cache eviction to reduce cold-starts for long-context workloads
  * New config knobs for batching and token budget per-tenant
- Known issues:
  * Rare truncation seen with very long prompts (>65k tokens) in staging; mitigation: auto-chunking enabled for impacted tenants
  * Short-lived increase in cost-per-token observed in synthetic load tests — monitoring enabled

Post-cutover tasks (first 24h):
- Collect sampling traces and run regression evals against canonical prompt set (Omar)
- Cost monitoring: compare rolling 24h egress and token spend vs baseline (Katherine)
- Postmortem: capture timeline and decision log if any gate trips (owner: Maya)

Open questions / To resolve before finalizing:
- Do we require manual DB migration lock during 22:00 migration step? (engineering-db)
- Confirm on-call escalation chain for vendor-managed GPUs (contact vendor ops)
- Should we increase canary slice to 20% if telemetry is quiet for 30 minutes? (decision deferred to SRE lead)

Notes to self: keep this file short and link to the full release canvas once PRs land. Use ‘Cutover Kiln’ as canonical name for postmortem artifacts so we can grep/aggregate easily.

Appendix: quick commands
- Rollback route: https://console.redwood.internal/routing/shift?release=stable
- Hotpatch deploy: gh pr checkout 789 && scripts/hotpatch.sh
- Artifact bucket: s3://redwood-release-artifacts/release-3142/

End of draft.
